verdict.rationale: AutoGen ships official, pip-installable Python SDK packages ('autogen-agentchat', 'autogen-ext[openai]'). They come with documented programmatic APIs for building agents, teams and runs, such as AssistantAgent and `await agent.run(...)`. A community user also reports working hands-on with the framework. Missing for 10: evidence of SDKs beyond Python, and an evidenced API reference or versioning/stability documentation for the SDK surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
